aortic_cusp_count.note: Requires an adequately resolved en-face aortic valve; not a PLAX or apical cusp-count claim.

A4C.note: No routine aortic-valve claim; RA size and local wall motion are optional priorities when explicitly abnormal.

A4C_LV.note: LV-focused: the LV and this view's valves are prefilled. LV function, valve findings and wall motion are claimed, never chamber size.

A2C_LV.note: LV-focused: the LV and this view's valves are prefilled. LV function, valve findings and wall motion are claimed, never chamber size.

A3C_LV.note: LV-focused: the LV and this view's valves are prefilled. LV function, valve findings and wall motion are claimed, never chamber size.

A5C.note: The A4C structures plus the LVOT, aortic valve and aortic root. Requires actual valve/color-box coverage; no gradient or stenosis grade in a B-mode loop.

PLAX.note: Optional local effusion. LV function may be assessed if adequate; not the preferred isolated EF route.

PLAX_DEEP.note: The PLAX structures plus the descending aorta; only pericardial effusion is claimed. Pericardial versus pleural fluid requires landmark assessment; descending aorta must not be labeled aortic root.

PSAX.note: The view classifier gives no PSAX level, so only structures seen at every level are prefilled and the reviewer states the level. The mitral valve is claimed at the basal/mitral and mid levels; papillary muscles, chordae and the mid wall segments at the mid level. A clip at the aortic valve level is PSAX_AV.

PSAX_AV.note: Valve/jet must be identified; aortic morphology is preferred en-face when systolic opening is captured. The pulmonic valve, proximal pulmonary artery and interatrial septum are prefilled too: untick them when they are not visible.

RVINF.note: Focused inflow view is not a complete RV quantification study.

SUBCOSTAL.note: The four-chamber subtype is prefilled; the reviewer switches an IVC sweep to the IVC subtype. IVC and chamber findings never mix.

SUPRASTERNAL.note: Arch observations only; spectral obstruction/velocity labels remain separate.

A2C_ZOOM.note: Zoomed: the base view's structures are prefilled; untick any outside the zoom (a tick means visible, even partly). Valve, root and chamber function findings are claimed, never chamber size.

uninterpretable_reasons.poor_quality: Poor image quality or artifacts throughout
uninterpretable_reasons.no_cardiac_structure: No identifiable cardiac structure (crop, zoom or depth)

prefill_policy: Explicit report values only, routed by view, mode, structures and level. Each view prefills its structures for the reviewer to confirm or untick (a tick means visible, even partly); a structure is never added by the reviewer. Suggestions are MAL drafts. No review_completed prelabel, no missing-to-normal inference, no automatic ground truth.
scoring_policy: Score immutable original columns; corrections and confirmed omissions are separate, and a finding ticked among the prefilled findings without being prefilled counts as a confirmed omission. Cannot assess is not an error or a negative. An uninterpretable clip is scored on nothing else and gets no caption. A PSAX or subcostal clip needs its level, and any other view has none. Exact report numbers remain context. Submitted review and exact input provenance gate release.
